answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. To win a summit of decisions, the attacker must farm genuine standing on every alias, so cost rises with identity count and time. Picture a tide field, a zenith in flight, a haven in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
